batch.description: Jahangirnagar University D Unit (Biological Sciences), academic session 2024-2025, Set-13 (সেটকোড: ১৩) — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading from the Udvash ‘জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক’ question-bank book PDF (ju-ad-abswer-combined.pdf), book PDF pages 97-100 (question pages), with the printed answer table and the printed worked solutions for Q55-58 on p.100. EXTRACTION STAGE: every question is marked content-unverified and every printed key answer-unverified pending cross-source verification; the printed publisher keys are NOT official JU keys. The book prints NO subject headings; subjects were assigned by content following the session's standard D-unit distribution, confirmed by the question sequence: Zoology Q1-22, Chemistry Q23-46, English Q47-50, Bangla Q51-54, General Mathematics (সাধারণ গণিত) Q55-58, Botany Q59-80. Botany/Zoology are recorded under the canonical subject Biology with the split kept in topic; the সাধারণ গণিত block keeps its source label ‘General Mathematics’. The answer table prints a dash (no answer) for Q9 and Q54. For Q9 the book also prints, directly under the question on p.97, ‘ব্যাখ্যা: প্রশ্নটি ত্রুটিপূর্ণ [সঠিক উত্তর: ১০-৪০μm]’, i.e. the question is defective and the stated correct value is not among the options; for Q54 no worked solution is printed. Both are therefore recorded with answerDisposition no_correct_option and an empty correctOptionIds list, and — only because the repo validator requires a ‘verified’ answer status for that disposition — their answerVerificationStatus is set to ‘verified’, where the verified fact is solely the printed no-correct-option state (same treatment as earlier packs in this project); their content remains unverified. Mathematical notation is linearised with ^ for superscripts; chemical formulae are written in plain linear form (e.g. FeSO4, K2Cr2O7). Printed peculiarities are preserved as printed and flagged in extraction notes (Q33 options b and d both ‘273 K’; Q62 option a ‘Peter Mitchel’; Q76 stem ‘সায়ানোফায়’). IMPORT COPY: verified subset (40/80) - see VERIFICATION report.

sourceDocuments.title: Udvash জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক (JU A & D Unit question bank, 2015–2025)
sourceDocuments.notes: Scanned book PDF (295 pp.). Set-13 (Unit-D, 2024-2025) occupies PDF pages 97-100 (printed book pages 96-99): questions on pp.97-100, answer table (‘উত্তরমালা ও ব্যাখ্যামূলক সমাধান’) and worked solutions for Q55-58 on p.100. PDF p.101 begins a different paper (Unit-D 2023-2024 Set-K) and was NOT transcribed into this pack. Transcription by direct visual reading of the page images (with zoomed crops for dense regions); OCR used only as a finding aid.
